history.sg_progress: The Office of Supply Chain Management monitors client entities’ demand plans and guides them on sourcing solutions through its supply chain planning framework. The framework provides demand and sourcing support to clients through: (a) Annual business guidance, which reflects the recommendations of category teams on the supply chain management catalogue of sourcing solutions, including hybrid and carbon-neutral vehicles; (b) Rolling reviews of clients’ supply plans; (c) Integrated business planning process meetings to discuss requirements, review supply chain plans and ensure demands are met with fit-for-purpose solutions. The Office will continue to: (a) Provide guidance on using hybrid and carbon-neutral vehicles to meet ground transportation needs, taking into account operational conditions and suitability; (b) Work with existing suppliers to expand the geographical coverage of the current contracts in order to give its clients more hybrid electric vehicle options; (c) Conduct market research on the hybrid electric vehicle marketplace to ensure it has the most up-to-date information on the vehicle types that may be available for global deployment through future systems contracts. The Office will directly target this market through a request for information to a wide supplier base, followed by direct meetings with vehicle manufacturers and authorized dealers.
